summary: Iteration 2 full-stack test of BUMDES app after 4 new features: (1) Dashboard TOTAL row, (2) Revenue-share DELETE per row, (3) Users admin-only + password reveal + reset + new roles pengawas/penasihat, (4) PDF word-wrap. Backend: 16/16 new + 33/33 regression = 49/49 pytest PASS (parallel worker race between password-reset test and users-list test is a test-only false positive; each file passes individually). Frontend: all critical UI flows verified via Playwright — dashboard TOTAL row, revshare create+delete, users reveal (••• -> admin123), reset password for riska (+login with new pw + restore original), direktur/pengawas sidebar RBAC, TEST_pengawas1 created/logged-in with correct navigation, WRITE buttons disabled for pengawas.

ui_bugs.issue: Manual navigation to /users as direktur/bendahara/pengawas/penasihat is redirected to '/' by the Protected route guard (roles=['admin']) instead of rendering the intended UsersPage 'users-page-forbidden' fallback. The forbidden panel in UsersPage.jsx is currently dead code. If the desired UX is to show 'Akses Ditolak' on the URL (as stated in the review request), remove the `roles` prop from the /users <Protected> in App.js and rely on the internal isAdmin check in UsersPage. Otherwise this is functionally fine (still blocks non-admin).

design_issues.screen: COAPage / MitraPage / RevenueShare / UsersPage (any <select> with dynamic <option>)
issues: Recurring dev-mode React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by visual-editing dev-instrumentation wrapping dynamic option text in a <span display:contents>. Not app code bug, stripped in production build. Same finding as iteration 1.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Decide whether /users direct URL should show forbidden panel or silently redirect. Currently route-guard redirects to '/', so UsersPage.jsx forbidden div is unreachable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still ~900 lines - split into routers (auth, users, transactions, reports, pdf) for maintainability.
plain_password stored in DB is a security concern (documented as intentional for admin recovery). At minimum enforce https-only + encrypt-at-rest, and document risk clearly.
PDF endpoints share table-building boilerplate — extract a helper `build_financial_table(rows, section_indices, total_index, col_widths)` to reduce duplication.

create_transaction and create_mitra do not restrict WRITE_LEVEL — pengawas/penasihat can currently POST transactions (only revenue-share/accounts/unit-usaha reject). Add `require_roles(*WRITE_LEVEL)` on POST /transactions and POST /mitra if pengawas/penasihat should be strictly read-only.
App.js /users route uses `roles=['admin']` guard which makes UsersPage's `users-page-forbidden` panel dead code — either remove the guard or remove the fallback.
test_credentials: admin/admin123, budianto/direktur123, riska/bendahara123 (riska password reset+restored during test — verified back to bendahara123).
seed_data_creation: Backend cleanup fixture removes all TEST_ prefixed users at end of test_new_features.py. Frontend test creates and cleans up TEST_pengawas1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testids added in iteration 2: unit-total-row (Dashboard), del-rs-<id> (RevenueShare row delete), users-page (admin), users-page-forbidden (currently unreachable via route guard), btn-toggle-reveal (global password reveal), pw-<userId> (per-row password cell), btn-reset-<userId> (per-row reset icon), reset-pw-form (reset modal), reset-pw-input, btn-confirm-reset, btn-del-<userId>. Backend RBAC: WRITE_LEVEL={admin,direktur,bendahara}, READ_LEVEL adds pengawas+penasihat. Note transactions/mitra POST are NOT gated by WRITE_LEVEL yet (dependency on get_current_user_payload only).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found. Minor observation about /users route being dual-guarded (route + component) leaving the component-level forbidden UI as dead code.
